tagline: A community marketplace powered by Apps Hub profiles.
description: Publish classified listings with photos, descriptions, categories, prices or free items. Browse a public catalog and manage your own listings with your existing Apps Hub account. Watch interesting listings, see owner-only view and watcher statistics, and start private conversations from either side. Desktop settings control categories, subcategories and listing validity. A free Moderation panel lets the administrator manage every listing and ban a profile from posting, and each affected person is told what changed in their own language. Premium adds credit-paid VIP packages that place promoted listings first, and photo verification of users before they can post in chosen categories.
capabilities: Public catalog with search, category and price filters.
Apps Hub accounts own and manage their listings.
Up to ten photos per listing.
Free items, location and optional public contact details.
Edit, activate, deactivate and delete personal listings.
Automatic expiry and reactivation of expired listings.
Bump an active listing once every 24 hours.
Desktop category, subcategory and validity settings.
Private conversations linked to listings, with unread counts and Apps Hub identities.
Per-listing currencies matching Regional Settings, with currency-specific price filters.
Watch listings and review them later from a dedicated Watched view.
Owner-only daily unique view counts and watcher statistics.
Sellers can start a private conversation with a watcher.
Premium VIP listings paid through administrator-defined Apps Hub credit packages.
Moderation panel that shows every listing, searchable and filterable by category, status and owner, to edit, move, activate, deactivate, end VIP or delete one listing or a whole selection.
Ban a profile from posting in Classifieds, with an optional reason, without touching its Apps Hub account.
System messages that tell people, in their own language, what moderation changed on their listings.
Premium user verification that asks for a photo before posting in chosen categories, triggered after registration, after a number of days or after a number of listings.

integrations.name: Any app
integrations.summary: Classifieds exposes an app-to-app API: other apps can list the categories and your own listings, and add, edit, bump, activate, deactivate or delete a listing on your behalf, under the same rules, bans and verifications as the public page.
integrations.requires: The Classifieds App API has to be switched on in Apps Hub → Settings → App APIs. It is off by default.
